92460.obj: Speak with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove. Description Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We've been awaiting your arrival and anticipating your much needed help here in Thendal Village. I imagine you are brimming with both nerves and excitement for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime. <Ailee smiles kindly.> Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey. Completion Gale's greetings, Unwanted. I am honored to bestow your coming of age relic today as you are recognized for the potential you bring to the shen'dorei. Our people have faced great hardship and persecution in our complex history. Today you are given this relic which is one of many held by those before you. Someday when your ashes are scattered to the winds it will pass to another to continue our tradition. As you take this relic with you know that the winds of home will be with you wherever you travel. Rewards You will receive: Ancient Heirloom Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

92461.obj: Slay 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove. Juvenile Vuldren slain

92462.obj: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove. Pesky Cirrusfly slain

92463.obj: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove. Cirrusfly Queen slain

92464.obj: Speak to the Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove. Learn more about the agitated winds.

92465.obj: Slay 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove. Al'Aketh Convert slain

92466.obj: Bring a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro. Signet of Akir

92467.obj: Find the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta. Provided item: Earth Sapta

92468.obj: Bring the Rough Quartz to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove. Rough Quartz

92469.obj: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove. Description You've done enough here, <class>. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there. Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased. Completion This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part. You've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, Ranir. Thank you. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Windblown Short Cloak Skychain Belt Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain: See if you've already completed this by typing: /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(92469)) <h2 class="h

92470.obj: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove. Ursera Scavenger slain

92471.obj: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove. Description You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face. The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle , and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more. Completion Rorian has told me much of you. I am likely unknown to you, but I am a member of the Council of Elders here on Zephras Isle. I've come to read the flow of the winds here in Thendal Grove. I'm also here to assess young shen'dorei such as yourself that are coming of age. So tell me, are you ready to take your next step? Are you ready to serve Zephras Isle ? Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

92472.obj: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village. Description One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day. Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you. Completion Aetheen sent you, then? I'll confess, you don't look like much to me, but Shen'dar Village won't turn down willing aid, much less aid sent from Elder Aetheen herself. Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain: See if you've already completed this by typing: /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(92472)) Related new Listview({ data: lv_comments0, id: 'comments', name: WH.TERMS.comments, parent: lkljbjkb574, sourceScopes: true, tab

92473.obj: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove. Scrawny Ursera Claw

92474.obj: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall. Description Well hello there, <name>! Want to play a game? All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float. The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah! Progress Using your ability to walk on air can get you out of--and, well... into--all kinds of trouble! Completion How many times do I need to tell Myriaal not to encourage others to make reckless usage of our skyborne gifts! That being said, I suppose that a little bit of practice in the relative safety of the village is... acceptable. In the future I'd simply suggest you to use your ability judiciously. You do not want to exhaust your magic thoughtlessly and then not be able to use it when you truly need it. Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

92482.obj: Read the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove. Scribbled Note

92483.obj: Read the Simple Note then speak with Akeri Duskblade within the watchtower in Thendal Grove. Simple Note

92484.obj: Examine the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove. Humming Recall Crystal

92485.obj: Read the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove. Folded Parchment

92514.obj: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village. Speak with Illaya Amberwind

92515.obj: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands. Prideclaw Pelt

92516.obj: Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths , 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands. Hippogryph Youth slain

92517.obj: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands. Highlands Bandit slain

92528.obj: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands. Learn about the cultists' plans

92529.obj: Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village. If you lose your Mark of Akir, speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village to regain the effect. Speak with Missionary Jasaan at the entrance to Falaath Village

92532.obj: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower. Crumpled Note

92544.obj: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes , 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes , and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove. Al'Aketh Brute slain

92550.obj: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers , 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas. Al'Aketh Stormcaller slain

92551.obj: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands. Stolen Shen'dar Supplies

92553.obj: Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands. Small Egg

92579.obj: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar. Aonda's Written Report

92595.obj: Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say. Listen to Illaya

92598.obj: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove. Use Skysight near the Elemental Convergence

92640.obj: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar and follow her instructions. Speak with Valennia Stormfist

92642.obj: Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands. Al'Aketh Healer slain

92643.obj: Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar. Find the secluded house in Shen'dar Highlands

92644.obj: Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. Glowing Crystal

92645.obj: Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands. Commander Belguilos slain

92646.obj: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna. Confront Lorthuna

92679.obj: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard. Find Aamelia Windfield

92682.obj: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard. Ripe Stormapple

92683.obj: Gather 5 Flutterfly Dust from the Flutterflies around the Gustberry Lowlands. Flutterfly Dust

92684.obj: Gather 7 Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloins from the Ornery Galestriders found throughout the Gustberry Lowlands. Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloin

92685.obj: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands. Blood-Stained Bandit Mask

92693.obj: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader. Speak with Aamelia Windfield

92698.obj: Speak with Aamelia Windfield about the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct. Description <You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>...Function error......Question......What is.......Function... <These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?> Completion The construct? It's been wandering around the fields for decades. Since the wind elementals left us, I think. Alvarion suspected that it used to haul harvests to market, or maybe tend to livestock back before this was an orchard. That could have been a thousand years ago though. In the old days, the Windshapers used to maintain these constructs. We've talked about petitioning them to come and take a look at it, but it's never been a pressing concern to us. Mostly we just ignore it these days. Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain: See if you've already completed this by typing: /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(92698)) Related //<![

92700.obj: Find Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar. Description Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar. You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar. Completion Elder Amberwind sent me a message about you and your exploits in Shen'dar Village. You are most welcome here, friend. You have a strong aura, and you clearly have a resonance with the spirits. Fewer and fewer of us have the skysight of late, and Zephras needs those with the gift if we are to survive these trying times. I am glad you have found your way to me. I look forward to further making your acquaintance. Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

92703.obj: Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar. Description I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, <name>. If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family. <Aamelia touches her belly gently.> He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now. Completion <Alvarion's eyes tear up as you finish retelling the story of what happened at the orchard.> I don't know how to thank you, friend. I came to Valanaar looking for hope. A vain hope, I was almost certain. But instead I found a hero. A real hero, like the stories from before we came to Skywall. I'll never forget what you did for us, Orsen. You'll always be welcome at the Windfield home. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Planting Shovel Roofing Hammer Trusty Wrench Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

92708.obj: Listen to what Ayessa Dawnsinger has to say. Listen to Ayessa

92871.obj: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the Windshapers are with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh. Description Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There's rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something. Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise. Completion You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation. Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

92880.obj: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar. Description I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now. I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that. May the four winds bless you, <class>. Completion <Valennia looks visibly relieved as you tell her about the status of the eastern watchtower.> Thank the winds. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Honed Greathammer Quickblade's Dagger Balanced Quarterstaff Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

92881.obj: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. Description The attack on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons. Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising. Completion I have a small matter that requires just the kind of assistance that an adventurer like yourself can provide. Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

92947.obj: Slay 8 Al'Aketh Guardians , 6 Al'Aketh Spiritcallers , and 6 Al'Aketh Blademasters , then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir. Al'Aketh Guardian slain

93036.obj: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village. Description You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but its obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer. You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village. Completion Greetings child, my name is Sania Silverstream and I am a junior priestess in the Order of the Al'Aketh. Do you wish to learn more of our sovereign, the Windlord Al'Akir? There is always room at the Windlord's table for the righteous and the repentant. Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

93065.obj: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands. Find Valennia on the Road

93090.obj: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle. Description Please extend my thanks to Ayessa for all that the Windshapers and your new friends from this "Earthen Ring" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the plan to take the Windshapers shamans and leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition. I can only hope that whatever solution the Windshapers find can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. Winds be with you, <name>. Completion I'm pleased to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time. Muln has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between Zephras Isle and a place called Mulgore, where the Earthen Ring make their home. We've been doing test voyages and some of our people are already waiting on the other side. Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

93159.obj: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him. Learn more about the Strange Hermit

93160.obj: Gather 8 Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest. Zephyrseed

93165.obj: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands. Al'Alketh Cultist's Ear

93172.obj: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest. Wind Hollow freed

93317.obj: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat. Windsong Crawler Meat

93318.obj: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil. Vulgara's Head

93319.obj: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands. Pilfered Windstone

93320.obj: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands. Description I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying. Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can. My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help. Completion We are holding them off for now, but they have greater numbers and our fighters are starting to get tired. We need to do something to break the stalemate, and do it fast. Rewards You will be able to choose one of these rewards: Defender's Bracers Windswept Slippers Peacekeeper's Legguards Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

93459.obj: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh in Shadowgale Forest, the Shine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands and return them to Vayn Moonclaw in Shadowgale Forest. Al'Alketh Cultist's Ear

93552.obj: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove. Windstone Cluster

93735.obj: Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar. Description Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional. One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can. Completion <Riaani's face is buried under the heaving armor plates of the construct, attempting to work on the mechanisms underneath. He does not notice your presence at all.> Storms curse where is the core?! Who thought it would be a good idea to remove the Gyrozephyr as well? It's a miracle this construct's winds haven't dissipated entirely by now! Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

93736.obj: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest. Wind Hollow Essence

93737.obj: Speak with Rianni Nightwind and list to what he has to say. Listen to what Riaani Nightwind has to say

93738.obj: Report back to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar. Description Brightwish, eh? So the High Order wanted to remove these components for some reason. But why though? The High Order has always been meddlesome, constantly wanting to experiment with the wind spirits' magic. They are too bold by a mile, and we've strictly forbade them from meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, but lately they've been testing our patience. I think you should report what you've learned back to Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can instruct you further on what to do. Completion Very interesting, so it was the High Order that was responsible for the construct breaking down? I know Belathaan. He's Valennia Stormfist's cousin and his mother was actually a Windshaper. It's disappointing that he was involved in this. I need to reflect on this for a moment. Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

93740.obj: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from the corpses of Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands. Al'Aketh Windstone Charm

93746.obj: Confront Belthaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir. Confront Belathaan Brightwish

93836.obj: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong

93926.obj: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower. Check in on the Western Watchtower in the Shen'dar Highlands

93927.obj: Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps. Bloody Note

93948.obj: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. Shadowsong Family Signet

93949.obj: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated 8 enchanted Skyhoppers. Enchanted Skyhopper Exterminated

93951.obj: Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands. Hippogryph Down

93958.obj: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir. Description Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left. I'll stay here and watch your back. Completion <Valennia looks gravely wounded.> Rewards You will receive: Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

94003.obj: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir. Skybreaker Bulwark

94006.obj: Speak with Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar. Description Greetings, <name>. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras. To find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further. Completion So, you wish to embrace the way of the claw, child? Very well. Let us speak. Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

94007.obj: Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar. Description Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion. Go to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming. Completion I am most glad that you came. Come, let us begin. Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain: See if you've already completed this by typing: /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(94007)) Related //<![CDATA[ var tabsRelated = new Tabs({parent: WH.ge('jkbfksdbl4'), trackable: "WoW Quest"}); new Listview({template: 'quest', id: 'see-also', name: WH.TERMS.seealso_stc, tabs: tabsRelated, parent: 'lkljbjkb574', data: [{"category":-261,"category2":4,"classs":4,"id":6061,"level":10,"name":"Taming the Beast","race":32,"reqclass":4,"reqlevel":10,"reqrace":32,"side":2,"xp":840,"envChange":{"status":"unchanged","labels":[],"lines":[]}},{"category":-261,"category2":4,"classs":4,"id":6062,"level":10,"name":"Taming the Beast","race":130,"reqclass":4,"reqlevel":10,"reqrace":130,"side":2,"xp":840,"envChange":{"status":"unchanged","labels":[],"lines

94013.obj: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar. Taming Rod

94050.obj: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar. Description You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet. Go with the winds, young <class>. Completion A fledgling <class>, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle. Remember, Gei, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date. 94411.obj: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands. High Order Apprentice defeated

94414.obj: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance. View the Anchor Pylon

94484.obj: Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest. Description A moment, if you will <name>. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue. With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able go, seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease. Completion Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent? <Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.> So the message did not get through. We are in dire straights indeed then. It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence. Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

94485.obj: Collect 8 Lady's Tear Moss. Lady's Tear Moss

94486.obj: Collect 20 feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest. Pristine Shriekling Feather

94487.obj: Collect 10 Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest. Bloody Heirloom

94488.obj: Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest. Commander Haalien's Severed Head

94489.obj: Enter the Nightfang Den and heal 7 druids and find Jorel Windsinger in Shadowgale Forest. Injured Druids healed

94490.obj: Bring the Ripped Missive to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest. Provided item: Ripped Missive

94491.obj: Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valannar and tell him what has transpired. Provided item: Mysterious Orders

94568.obj: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation. Learn what you can from the crystal

94638.obj: Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands. Ur'endra slain

94896.obj: Collect 8 Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal. Abandoned Belongings

94897.obj: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal. Resaan's Heirloom

94978.obj: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Windsong Crawler found near bodies of water. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar. Taming Rod

94979.obj: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar. Taming Rod

95349.obj: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alana Stormwalker when you arrive. Description The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive you upon your arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon. When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there. Banu-Alah, <name>. Completion More adventurers from Zephras, I see. Wonderful. The winds surely favor us! It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore this new land. Azeroth is an exciting new world, but it's also a dangerous world. You'd do well to prepare yourself for this new adventure by familiarizing yourself with the lands nearby. Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

96101.obj: Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire by typing /sit in the chat window and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff. Use the /sit emote near the campfire

96638.obj: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village. Description More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove. Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels. Completion Well met!
